title: PRISM PRODUCT — Customer-Value Feature Roadmap
description: Features prioritized by revenue impact from 5 customer perspectives: shop owner, programmer, dealer, CAM vendor, training institution

units.title: PRISM-PRODUCT-roadmap — Coordinator
units.description: Master coordinator envelope for PRISM-PRODUCT-roadmap. Tracks sub-milestones, aggregates their exit gates, and opens closure after every child milestone flips to complete. Follow 4-LOOP at the aggregation layer.
exit_conditions: All sub-milestones listed in dependencies reach status=complete
Cross-track coherence verified: no orphan engines, no duplicate actions
Final /rgs pass through the 10-agent gate returns PASS

milestones_list.title: ROI Proof Engine — Cost Savings Tracker + Scrap Reduction Reports
milestones_list.smart: Role: Applied Math/Physics + Business Analyst | OPUS | HIGH

units_detail.title: CostSavingsTrackerEngine — persistent event log
units_detail.smart: Role: Senior TS Engineer + Data Scientist | OPUS | HIGH
units_detail.description: Engine that logs every PRISM recommendation (S/F, tool change, RPM) with timestamp, predicted outcome, and optional actual outcome. Persistent JSON store at ~/.prism/savings.json. Actions: log_recommendation, log_outcome, query_savings, reset_period.
units_detail.exit: Engine passes 15+ tests, persists across sessions

units_detail.title: ScrapReductionReportEngine — monthly value reports
units_detail.smart: Role: Business Analyst + Data Scientist | SONNET | MEDIUM
units_detail.description: Generates monthly/weekly reports showing: crashes prevented (from safety analyzer), tool life savings (Taylor predictions vs premature changes), cycle time reductions (before/after S/F optimization), scrap cost avoided. Output: structured report with dollar amounts.

units_detail.title: ROI Dashboard data model
units_detail.smart: Role: Database Architect + API Specialist | SONNET | MEDIUM
units_detail.description: Define the data model for ROI tracking: savings_events, tool_changes, crash_avoidances, cycle_time_deltas. Aggregate queries for daily/weekly/monthly/yearly views. Compatible with future PostgreSQL migration.

units_detail.title: Wire to existing engines for auto-logging
units_detail.smart: Role: Senior TS Engineer | SONNET | MEDIUM
units_detail.description: Hook into SpeedFeedOrchestrator, GCodeSafetyAnalyzer, ToolLifeCountdown to auto-log savings events. Each time PRISM optimizes S/F, catches a safety issue, or extends tool life, a savings event is recorded automatically.

units_detail.title: CLI: prism roi — show savings summary
units_detail.smart: Role: Senior TS Engineer | HAIKU | LOW
units_detail.description: Add 'prism roi' CLI command that prints: This month: $X saved across N recommendations. Breakdown by category (tool life, cycle time, crash prevention).

units_detail.title: Dispatcher actions + MCP resource
units_detail.smart: Role: API Specialist | SONNET | MEDIUM
units_detail.description: Wire to businessDispatcher: roi_summary, roi_log, roi_report, roi_reset. Add MCP resource: savings://prism/current for dashboard consumption.
units_detail.exit: 4 actions wired, MCP resource returns data

milestones_list.title: Programmer Productivity Engine — Gamified Performance Tracking
milestones_list.smart: Role: Data Scientist + Senior TS Engineer | OPUS | HIGH

units_detail.title: ProgrammerProductivityEngine — metrics tracker
units_detail.smart: Role: Data Scientist + Senior TS Engineer | OPUS | HIGH
units_detail.description: Track per-user metrics: programs checked, crashes prevented, cycle time saved, S/F optimizations applied, tribal tips viewed, academy progress. Leaderboard scoring. Persistent store at ~/.prism/productivity.json.

units_detail.title: Achievement system — badges and milestones
units_detail.smart: Role: Senior TS Engineer | SONNET | MEDIUM
units_detail.description: Define 20+ achievements: First Optimization, 100 Programs Checked, Crash Preventer (10 crashes avoided), Speed Demon (1000 S/F calcs), Material Master (all ISO groups used), etc. Unlockable badges with progress tracking.

units_detail.title: Weekly digest generator
units_detail.smart: Role: Business Analyst | HAIKU | LOW
units_detail.description: Generate weekly summary: 'This week you optimized 47 programs, saved est. 12.3 hours of cycle time, prevented 2 potential crashes. You earned the Speed Demon badge!'

units_detail.title: Team comparison (anonymized)
units_detail.smart: Role: Data Scientist | SONNET | MEDIUM
units_detail.description: For multi-user shops: show how your optimization rate compares to team average. 'You're in the top 20% for cycle time improvement this month.' Privacy-preserving aggregate stats.

units_detail.title: Wire to dispatchers + CLI
units_detail.smart: Role: Senior TS Engineer | HAIKU | LOW
units_detail.description: businessDispatcher: productivity_summary, productivity_achievements, productivity_digest, productivity_compare. CLI: prism stats.

milestones_list.title: Instructor Dashboard Engine — Academy LMS Features
milestones_list.smart: Role: Senior TS Engineer + Technical Doc Lead | OPUS | HIGH

units_detail.title: InstructorDashboardEngine — class management
units_detail.smart: Role: Senior TS Engineer + Database Architect | OPUS | HIGH
units_detail.description: Create/manage classes with enrolled students, assigned courses, due dates. Instructor can see all student progress, grades, time spent. Supports multiple classes per instructor.

units_detail.title: Assignment engine — custom assessments
units_detail.smart: Role: Senior QA Engineer | SONNET | MEDIUM
units_detail.description: Instructors create custom assignments: select questions from AssessmentEngine pool, set time limits, due dates. Auto-grading with override capability.

units_detail.title: Grade export — CSV/PDF report cards
units_detail.smart: Role: Senior TS Engineer | HAIKU | LOW
units_detail.description: Export student grades as CSV (for LMS import) or PDF report cards. Include: course completion %, quiz scores, time spent, certification status.

units_detail.title: Student analytics — learning patterns
units_detail.smart: Role: Data Scientist | SONNET | MEDIUM
units_detail.description: Identify struggling students (low quiz scores, long time per module), fast learners (ready for next course), and knowledge gaps (specific topics with low scores across class).

units_detail.title: Content authoring — custom lessons
units_detail.smart: Role: Technical Doc Lead | SONNET | MEDIUM
units_detail.description: Instructors can create custom lessons using PRISM's content types (text, calculator, formula card, quiz). Insert from existing 146 modules or create new.

units_detail.title: Wire to knowledgeDispatcher + MCP
units_detail.smart: Role: API Specialist | SONNET | MEDIUM
units_detail.description: knowledgeDispatcher: instructor_create_class, instructor_enroll, instructor_grades, instructor_analytics, instructor_export, instructor_assign. MCP resource: academy://prism/classes.

milestones_list.title: White-Label Config Engine — Dealer/OEM Branding
milestones_list.smart: Role: Principal Systems Architect | SONNET | MEDIUM

units_detail.title: WhiteLabelConfigEngine — brand customization
units_detail.smart: Role: Principal Systems Architect | SONNET | MEDIUM
units_detail.description: Configure: company name, logo URL, color scheme, default machine fleet, pre-loaded tool library, custom greeting, support URL. Stored in ~/.prism/brand.json.

units_detail.title: Machine fleet pre-configuration
units_detail.smart: Role: Manufacturing Expert | SONNET | MEDIUM
units_detail.description: Dealer selects which machines from 910 profiles are relevant for their customer. PRISM filters recommendations to only those machines. Tool library scoped to compatible tools.
units_detail.exit: Fleet filter works across all engines

units_detail.title: Custom tribal tips injection
units_detail.smart: Role: Senior TS Engineer | HAIKU | LOW
units_detail.description: Dealer can add custom tribal tips tagged with their brand. Tips appear alongside PRISM's 3700+ with dealer attribution.
units_detail.exit: Custom tips appear in playbook queries

units_detail.title: Wire + CLI: prism brand
units_detail.smart: Role: Senior TS Engineer | HAIKU | LOW
units_detail.description: businessDispatcher: brand_configure, brand_status, brand_reset. CLI: prism brand set/show.

milestones_list.title: CAM Plugin SDK — Embeddable Physics API
milestones_list.smart: Role: API Specialist + Principal Systems Architect | OPUS | HIGH

units_detail.title: CAMPluginSDKEngine — lightweight API wrapper
units_detail.smart: Role: API Specialist + Senior TS Engineer | OPUS | HIGH
units_detail.description: Thin wrapper exposing PRISM's physics as a simple API: optimizeSpeedFeed(material, tool, operation) -> {rpm, feed, doc, woc, confidence}. Also: checkSafety(gcode), suggestTool(material, operation), getTribalTip(cam, operation). <50ms response target.

units_detail.title: OpenAPI 3.1 spec auto-generation
units_detail.smart: Role: API Specialist | SONNET | MEDIUM
units_detail.description: Auto-generate OpenAPI spec from Zod schemas for all 67+ dispatchers. Swagger UI at /api/docs. Enables developer self-service.

units_detail.title: Rate limiting + API key management
units_detail.smart: Role: Senior Security Auditor | OPUS | HIGH
units_detail.description: Per-key rate limits: free=100/day, pro=10K/day, enterprise=unlimited. API key CRUD with scoping (read-only, compute, admin). Token bucket algorithm.
units_detail.exit: Rate limits enforce per key tier

units_detail.title: SDK client libraries (TypeScript + Python)
units_detail.smart: Role: Senior TS Engineer | SONNET | MEDIUM
units_detail.description: Auto-generate TypeScript and Python client libraries from OpenAPI spec. npm: @prism/sdk, pip: prism-manufacturing-sdk. Include type definitions and examples.
units_detail.exit: Both SDKs install and call API successfully

units_detail.title: Developer portal + getting started guide
units_detail.smart: Role: Technical Doc Lead | SONNET | MEDIUM
units_detail.description: Markdown docs: Getting Started (5 min), API Reference (auto-gen), Examples (speed/feed, safety check, tool selection), Rate Limits, Authentication.

milestones_list.title: SaaS REST API Layer — HTTP Access to All Dispatchers
milestones_list.smart: Role: API Specialist + Senior Security Auditor | OPUS | HIGH

units_detail.title: Express REST routes wrapping MCP dispatchers
units_detail.smart: Role: API Specialist + Senior TS Engineer | OPUS | HIGH
units_detail.description: POST /api/v2/{dispatcher}/{action} routes that validate auth, parse body, call dispatcher, return JSON. All 70 dispatchers accessible. CORS configured.

units_detail.title: Usage metering + billing integration
units_detail.smart: Role: Database Architect + Business Analyst | SONNET | MEDIUM
units_detail.description: Track API calls per key per day. Stripe integration for billing (metered pricing). Usage dashboard endpoint: GET /api/v2/usage.
units_detail.exit: Usage counts tracked, Stripe webhook processes

units_detail.title: Webhook notifications
units_detail.smart: Role: Senior TS Engineer | SONNET | MEDIUM
units_detail.description: Customers register webhook URLs for events: tool_life_warning, safety_violation, job_complete, alarm_triggered. POST to webhook with signed payload.

units_detail.title: GraphQL alternative endpoint
units_detail.smart: Role: API Specialist | SONNET | MEDIUM
units_detail.description: Optional GraphQL endpoint at /api/graphql for clients who prefer query flexibility. Schema auto-generated from dispatcher schemas.
units_detail.exit: GraphQL playground works with all dispatchers

units_detail.title: API versioning + deprecation policy
units_detail.smart: Role: Principal Systems Architect | HAIKU | LOW
units_detail.description: Version prefix /api/v2/. Header: X-PRISM-Deprecation for sunset dates. Migration guide template.

milestones_list.title: Shop Floor Kiosk Engine — Touch-First Interface Data
milestones_list.smart: Role: Manufacturing Expert + Senior Frontend Engineer | SONNET | MEDIUM

units_detail.title: KioskModeEngine — simplified data provider
units_detail.smart: Role: Manufacturing Expert + Senior TS Engineer | SONNET | MEDIUM
units_detail.description: Provides kiosk-optimized data: large text, minimal fields, big touch targets. Actions: kiosk_quick_sf (3-tap: material->tool->go), kiosk_alarm_decode, kiosk_setup_sheet, kiosk_tool_life.

units_detail.title: Quick S/F calculator — 3-tap flow
units_detail.smart: Role: Manufacturing Expert | SONNET | MEDIUM
units_detail.description: Step 1: Pick material (top 20 with photos). Step 2: Pick tool type + diameter. Step 3: Results with big RPM/Feed numbers. Operator-friendly, no jargon.

units_detail.title: Alarm scanner — type code, get fix
units_detail.smart: Role: Manufacturing Expert | HAIKU | LOW
units_detail.description: Big input field for alarm code. Instant results: alarm meaning, probable cause, fix steps (numbered), related tribal tips.

units_detail.title: Tool life tracker — scan/enter tool
units_detail.smart: Role: Manufacturing Expert + Data Scientist | SONNET | MEDIUM
units_detail.description: Enter tool ID -> see remaining life %, estimated parts remaining, Taylor prediction vs actual. Color-coded: green/yellow/red. Optional barcode scanner integration.
units_detail.exit: Tool life display with color coding

units_detail.title: Wire to machineLiveDispatcher
units_detail.smart: Role: Senior TS Engineer | HAIKU | LOW
units_detail.description: machineLiveDispatcher: kiosk_quick_sf, kiosk_alarm, kiosk_setup, kiosk_tool_life. Simplified schemas with required-only fields.

milestones_list.title: Docker + CI/CD Pipeline — One-Command Deployment
milestones_list.smart: Role: Principal Systems Architect + Performance Specialist | OPUS | HIGH

units_detail.title: Dockerfile + docker-compose.yml
units_detail.smart: Role: Principal Systems Architect | OPUS | HIGH
units_detail.description: Multi-stage Dockerfile: build (tsc+esbuild) -> runtime (node:22-alpine). docker-compose with server + web + optional postgres. Single 'docker compose up' to run entire stack.

units_detail.title: GitHub Actions CI — lint + test on PR
units_detail.smart: Role: Senior TS Engineer | SONNET | MEDIUM
units_detail.description: .github/workflows/ci.yml: checkout, npm ci, tsc --noEmit, vitest run. Status checks on PR. Fail-fast on type errors.

units_detail.title: GitHub Actions CD — build + push Docker image
units_detail.smart: Role: Principal Systems Architect | SONNET | MEDIUM
units_detail.description: On tag push: build Docker image, push to GitHub Container Registry. Semantic versioning from package.json.

units_detail.title: ARCHITECTURE.md + GETTING_STARTED.md
units_detail.smart: Role: Technical Doc Lead | SONNET | MEDIUM
units_detail.description: Architecture doc: 11-layer diagram, key engines, data flow. Getting Started: clone, npm install, npm run dev, first API call in 5 minutes.

units_detail.title: SECURITY.md + dependency audit
units_detail.smart: Role: Senior Security Auditor | OPUS | HIGH
units_detail.description: Document: OAuth 2.1 flow, JWT lifecycle, RBAC matrix, rate limiting, input validation (Zod). Run npm audit, fix critical/high. Add Dependabot config.

milestones_list.title: Desktop App Shell (Tauri) — Offline Manufacturing Intelligence
milestones_list.smart: Role: Senior Frontend Engineer + Principal Systems Architect | OPUS | HIGH

units_detail.title: Tauri shell — wrap web app in native window
units_detail.smart: Role: Senior Frontend Engineer | OPUS | HIGH
units_detail.description: Initialize Tauri project. Embed mcp-server/web as frontend. Configure window title, icon, menu. Target: Windows + macOS + Linux.

units_detail.title: Embedded MCP server — offline sidecar
units_detail.smart: Role: Principal Systems Architect | OPUS | HIGH
units_detail.description: Bundle MCP server as Tauri sidecar process. stdio transport for local communication. No network required for core calculations.

units_detail.title: File associations — .nc, .stp, .igs
units_detail.smart: Role: Senior Frontend Engineer | SONNET | MEDIUM
units_detail.description: Register file associations: double-click .nc opens in PRISM (G-code viewer + safety check). .stp/.igs triggers STEP import + feasibility analysis.

units_detail.title: System tray — machine status
units_detail.smart: Role: Senior Frontend Engineer | SONNET | MEDIUM
units_detail.description: System tray icon showing machine connection status (via MTConnect/MQTT). Click for quick status popup. Notification on alarm or tool life warning.

units_detail.title: Auto-updater — GitHub Releases
units_detail.smart: Role: Principal Systems Architect | HAIKU | LOW
units_detail.description: Tauri updater plugin checking GitHub Releases for new versions. User notification + one-click update.

units_detail.title: CourseBuilderEngine — auto-generate from tribal tips
units_detail.smart: Role: Senior TS Engineer + Manufacturing Expert | OPUS | HIGH
units_detail.description: Auto-generate lesson content from 3700+ tribal tips. Group by CAM system, operation, material. Add quiz questions from playbook rules. One command: buildCourse(camSystem, level) -> full course.

units_detail.title: Quiz from playbook rules

units_detail.description: Auto-generate scenario-based quiz questions from 296+ playbook rules. 'You're face milling 304 stainless with a 50mm cutter. What's the recommended approach?' with physics-validated correct answer.

units_detail.title: Student progress persistence
units_detail.smart: Role: Database Architect | SONNET | MEDIUM
units_detail.description: Persist student progress, quiz scores, badges, certification status. Multi-device sync via server. Leaderboard across organization.

units_detail.title: CAM comparison modules
units_detail.smart: Role: Manufacturing Expert | SONNET | MEDIUM
units_detail.description: Side-by-side comparison modules for 18 CAM systems. Student picks primary CAM, sees how concepts apply in their tool. Cross-CAM strategy recommendations.

units_detail.title: Video integration — VideoLearningEngine content
units_detail.smart: Role: Senior TS Engineer | SONNET | MEDIUM
units_detail.description: Embed VideoLearningEngine extracted knowledge into course modules. Video clips with AI-extracted annotations, linked to relevant PRISM engines.

units_detail.description: Define tiers: Free (courses 0A-0C), Individual ($29/mo, all courses), Team ($19/seat/mo, 5+ seats, instructor dashboard), Enterprise (custom, white-label). Stripe integration points.
